title: ITCM VMA for .itcm_text / .ramfunc: linker + region-table copy
scope: Audit stock vs openCFW ITCM/ramfunc placement; fix g2-apollo-main.ld so .itcm_text has ITCM VMA and MRAM LMA, copied at startup. Rebuild apollo-main. Re-run version-match and mismatch sims. No hardware flash. NVM not in this step.

stock_itcm.startup_copy: Region table 0x75D3E0 LZ77 row installs 24 B at 0x40..0x58 (delay countdown + word copy). No other stock startup row targets ITCM.
stock_itcm.iar_section: .textrw: VMA ITCM, LMA MRAM (findings-apollo-platform.md). Stock main's delay_us at 0x4807a0 (MRAM) bl's 0x40.
stock_itcm.mram_busy: nv_program_main2 is bootrom. am_hal_mram_* callers live in MRAM and call into bootrom; no openCFW .itcm_text MRAM-wait helper was linked. spotmgr WFI helper copies a 6-instruction WFI sequence onto the stack (WFIRAM) rather than requiring .itcm_text for the WFI itself.

opencfw_before.problem: g2-apollo-main.ld merged *(.itcm_text) into MRAM .text. Ambiq HAL functions marked .itcm_text therefore executed from MRAM.
linked_itcm_text_contributors: am_hal_utils.c: br_util_delay_cycles, internal_hal_read_word, internal_hal_read_words (0x18 B total in the image)
not_in_image: am_hal_spotmgr_pcm2_2.c am_hal_spotmgr_wfi_wait (.itcm_text in upstream source) is absent from the generated boot pcm2_2 object that the build links
No .ramfunc sections present in any apollo-main object under clang (IAR __ramfunc path unused)
opencfw_before.app_dead_angle: Code that must run while MRAM is busy or powered down cannot fetch from MRAM. The only linked .itcm_text was the delay/read helpers; they are also performance-critical for GPIO15. A true MRAM-busy hang was not reproduced, but leaving ramfuncs in MRAM is a strong structural risk.

linker.ITCM: ORIGIN 0x58, LENGTH 0x3FFA8 (leaves 0x40..0x58 for the stock overlay)

fix.region_table: New g2c_copy_init3 row: __itcm_text_load_start -> __itcm_text_start..__itcm_text_end, after the 0x40 overlay copy and before .data
fix.am_hal_utils: Restored local-label 16-bit bne loops for br_util_delay_cycles and internal_hal_read_words (GNU assembled global-symbol BNE as bne.w).

am_hal_delay_us.note: stays in MRAM; calls ITCM br_util (stock pattern)

image.overlay: still copied to 0x40..0x58; preloaded itcm.bin unchanged

next: Implement EM9305 NVM program/erase starting with HCI 0xFD06 EMSMM_NVMEraseMain, then the mismatch pair through a completed DFU, then (3) case-reply disarm.
